Markets.title: Target Corp shares rise 5% as sales rebound and profit doubles in Q2
Markets.summary: Target shares rose 5% after second-quarter sales increased 5.3% and customer traffic grew 3.6%. Earnings per share doubled to $4.11, largely driven by tariff refunds and a 20% rise in underlying earnings.

Markets.title: Rs 3 crore to Rs 4,925 crore: Sebi order gives details on Dhenu Buildcon market cap surge
Markets.summary: Sebi alleged that Dhenu Buildcon artificially inflated its market capitalization from Rs 3 crore to Rs 4,925 crore despite having negligible revenue. The regulator has restricted the company from the securities market while it investigates the suspicious routing and conversion of funds.

Markets.title: SanDisk shares soar 3,400% in one year. Can the rally sustain its momentum?
Markets.summary: US stock futures edged higher following a tech-led market selloff. Investors are currently monitoring tensions involving Iran and upcoming retail earnings reports.

Markets.title: US stocks: US market opens up after tech-led slump as yields ease; earnings watched
Markets.summary: Wall Street indexes opened higher on Wednesday, recovering from the previous session's tech-led slump as government bond yields retreated from multi-decade highs. Investors also monitored a new round of corporate earnings reports during early trading.

Markets.title: Escorts Kubota announces Rs 2,000 cr investment on new plant in UP
Markets.summary: Escorts Kubota is investing Rs 2,000 crore to build a new manufacturing plant in Uttar Pradesh. The facility will produce tractors, farm implements, and construction equipment for international markets.

Markets.title: L&T buys over 2 cr units of Nxt-Infra Trust for Rs 199 cr
Markets.summary: Larsen & Toubro bought over two crore units of Nxt-Infra Trust for Rs 199 crore through an open market transaction on the NSE. A K Capital Finance sold an equivalent number of units in the same trust during the transaction.

Geo-Political.title: Israel confirms it opened fire on vehicle carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza

Geo-Political.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine's recently dismissed defense minister has urged the country to hold a presidential election. Elections are currently suspended because Ukraine has been under martial law since February 2022.

Geo-Political.title: Mushroom murderer trial undermined by 'catastrophic' hotel mix-up, appeal court told
Geo-Political.summary: Erin Patterson's defense team is appealing her conviction for murdering relatives with a toxic mushroom beef Wellington. The appeal argues that a catastrophic hotel mix-up by authorities compromised the integrity of the trial.

Geo-Political.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada for three days, saying deal close
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump delayed new tariffs on Canadian goods for three days. He stated that both nations are currently finalizing a trade deal to prevent the import taxes.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
Geo-Political.summary: South Korea has shortened its joint military exercises with the United States. The decision follows President Trump's announcement to curtail these drills due to his favorable relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in FY27 due to foreign currency non-resident deposits. However, experts warn this surplus may not strengthen the rupee unless the inflows actually enter the market rather than being absorbed as reserves.

Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated that the central bank requires clearer evidence of persistent inflation before adjusting policy rates. His comments were recorded in the minutes from the August Monetary Policy Committee meeting.

Data & Insights.summary: Data from IHMCL reveals how high-volume corridors, changing private involvement, and FASTag annual passes shape India's highway toll revenue. These factors collectively drive the economic model behind the country's toll collection and distribution systems.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research has raised India's projected GDP growth rate for the 2027 fiscal year to 6.8%. However, ongoing downside risks include the West Asia conflict, high inflation, currency depreciation, and lower-than-expected capital expenditure.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The government is speeding up agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes from El Nino and weak monsoon risks. This increased financial support aims to cushion rural consumption and mitigate the impact of poor weather on farming.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research predicts India will achieve a $50 billion balance of payments surplus for fiscal year 2027. This financial surplus will be driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

India.title: 3 Killed, 3 Injured As CNG Cylinder Explodes At Fuel Pump In Delhi
India.summary: A CNG cylinder exploded at a fuel pump in Delhi while gas was being pumped into a truck. The blast resulted in the deaths of three people and left three others injured.

India.title: For Punjab Polls, Satish Poonia May Use Haryana Blueprint, Team From Rajasthan
India.summary: BJP leader Satish Poonia plans to use his successful Haryana election strategy for the upcoming Punjab polls. This approach involves deploying party workers from Rajasthan to leverage their personal contacts and assist with local election management in border districts.

India.title: "We Are Gen Z" Is New "Jaanta Nahin Mera Baap Kaun Hai": Omar Abdullah
India.summary: National Conference leader Omar Abdullah stated that "We are Gen Z" has replaced the entitled phrase "Jaanta nahin mera baap kaun hai" in India. This cultural shift follows the association of the term "Gen Z" with student protests in Delhi since June.

India.title: Jharkhand Students Suspend 26-Day Protest, Give Government 2-Month Ultimatum
India.summary: Jharkhand students suspended their 26-day protest after the state government canceled 22 recruitment exams and ordered an investigation into 23 others. The students gave the government a two-month ultimatum to address their remaining demands.

India.title: Tourists Thrashed, Harassed For 2 Hours Over 8-Year-Old's Shorts At Pune Fort
India.summary: Pune police registered a case against nine people for assaulting and harassing tourists for two hours at Sinhagad Fort on August 16. The attackers targeted the visitors over an eight-year-old child's shorts.
